'''Star Tours Flight 410''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was on time and set to arrive at the spaceport's Gate 1F at 1220 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1310.
